# Eduardo Osteicoechea - BIM Software Developer

Eduardo Osteicoechea is a licensed Building Architect (Universidad de Los Andes, Cum Laude) and BIM Software Developer. Remote. Fluent English, native Spanish.

He builds and maintains C#/.NET add-ins for Revit and AutoCAD, cloud automations on Autodesk Platform Services (APS) and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), ASP.NET Core APIs on AWS, and Python/Dynamo scripts for design automation. Current employment includes BIM Full Stack Developer (.NET & AI) work at Hexagon Multivista (formerly Voyansi): Revit model validation, APS/ACC dashboards, AI rendering from Revit views, and agentic development workflows.

## Public surfaces on eduardoos.com

- Professional profile home, portfolio case studies, HTML/PDF CV, and contact.
- eReport: issue tracker with cloud storage, sharing, website registration connector, and API keys.
- eoProject: construction project stages, photos, and IFC versions.
- eApi /api-docs: documented product APIs for connectors.
- Subscriptions for the public products above.

Other platform tools (pamphlet, articles, scrib, homescool, evoice, emusic, eeyes, latin institutes) are private / admin-only and are not part of the public profile.

## Stack (summary)

C#, .NET Framework 4.8, .NET 8/9, ASP.NET Core, WPF, Windows Forms, Revit API, AutoCAD API, APS, ACC, Dynamo, Python, PowerShell (basic), SQL Server, MongoDB, TypeScript, React, Go REST APIs, AWS (EC2, S3, CloudFront, Route 53, DynamoDB, Lambda, SQS, ECR), Linux, Nginx, Docker, GitHub Actions.

## Education note

Autodesk Authorized Training Center Course (2011) and BIMMASTER.org Advanced BIM Modeling are professional training - not a conferred Master’s degree.
